# Will your mini-golf course pay for itself? Payback, debt coverage and break-even rounds per day

> Free pro forma for a mini-golf, putt-putt or small family fun center: build cost per hole and shared costs, rounds per day and price by season, parties, concessions and arcade, staff, fixed costs, rain-out days and a loan become operating income, debt coverage, payback and break-even rounds per day.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
